en: A panoramic, vintage, colorized image showing a seaside city with numerous fishing boats and ships anchored near a long breakwater. The city beyond features a dense cluster of low-rise historic European-style buildings and a prominent minaret, suggesting a diverse cultural influence. The reverse of the postcard shows handwritten messages, Bulgarian text, a Bulgarian postage stamp featuring a portrait, and several postal markings.
